entries.name: log
entries.summary: Expand {expression} placeholders using the current execution context and write the message to the logger.
entries.returns: Stores the expanded message in ___last_exec_result___. Unknown placeholders remain unchanged.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: One or more message tokens; quoted text may contain spaces.

entries.name: respond
entries.summary: Finish the current request with an HTTP status and response body.
entries.returns: HTTP response. Context objects are serialized as JSON text. The native REST handler uses a text/plain response body; generated OpenAPI documents detected status codes with a string response schema.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: HTTP status integer; defaults to 200 if absent or not parseable.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: A context variable name or literal text; defaults to OK.

notes: OpenAPI status inference is static: dynamically produced statuses are not discovered, and response values are documented as text strings rather than inferred Rune/JSON schemas.

entries.name: parse-json
entries.summary: Parse a JSON string stored in the request context.
entries.returns: Writes parsed JSON to the assignment target, or body when unassigned, and ___last_exec_result___.
entries.errors: Malformed JSON raises a builtin error (HTTP 500 in a native REST request). A missing or non-string source leaves the context unchanged.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Context variable containing a JSON string; defaults to body.

entries.name: fetch
entries.summary: Perform an outbound HTTP GET and return {status, body}.
entries.returns: Writes the response (fetch: {status, body}; fetch-json: parsed JSON) to the assignment target and ___last_exec_result___.
entries.errors: GET only; http/https only; 10s timeout, 1 MiB cap. Native REST: 502 for upstream non-2xx/bad JSON/network errors, 504 on timeout, unless a catch handler is given. Rune-Web: failures call the catch action; browser CORS rules apply.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: http(s) URL literal, or a name (e.g. an @Values entry) holding one.

parameters.name: catch
parameters.description: Optional: func/action called with the error ($1 / payload {status, message}).

notes: @Values entries are read-only and native-only. See knowledge/runtime/fetch.md.

entries.name: fetch-json
entries.summary: Perform an outbound HTTP GET and parse the body as JSON.
entries.returns: Writes the response (fetch: {status, body}; fetch-json: parsed JSON) to the assignment target and ___last_exec_result___.
entries.errors: GET only; http/https only; 10s timeout, 1 MiB cap. Native REST: 502 for upstream non-2xx/bad JSON/network errors, 504 on timeout, unless a catch handler is given. Rune-Web: failures call the catch action; browser CORS rules apply.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: http(s) URL literal, or a name (e.g. an @Values entry) holding one.

parameters.name: catch
parameters.description: Optional: func/action called with the error ($1 / payload {status, message}).

notes: @Values entries are read-only and native-only. See knowledge/runtime/fetch.md.

entries.name: validate
entries.summary: Validate required scalar fields against a named schema, or check a comparison.
entries.returns: Schema form stores the validated value in ___last_exec_result___. Validation failures finish the request with HTTP 400.
entries.errors: Missing field, type mismatch, or unknown schema/value. Additional properties are accepted; nested/optional schema validation is not implemented by this path.

parameters.name: Schema
parameters.description: An @Schema name; supported scalar field types are string, number, bool.

entries.name: csv.read
entries.summary: Read CSV records. Relative file resolution uses the app/script path and filesystem candidates.
entries.returns: Array of objects whose CSV field values are strings. Writes the assigned variable and ___last_exec_result___.
entries.errors: Missing filename is an error. An unreadable file logs a warning and assigns an empty array.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Context data or assignment target, as shown in the signature.

entries.name: csv.write
entries.summary: Replace a CSV file with records. Relative file resolution uses the app/script path and filesystem candidates.
entries.returns: Writes a header from the first object and rows from the supplied context array.
entries.errors: Missing/non-array variable and write failures are errors. Values are written through their string representation path; do not assume JSON numeric values are preserved.

parameters.name: rows
parameters.description: Context data or assignment target, as shown in the signature.

entries.name: csv.append
entries.summary: Append a record to a CSV file. Relative file resolution uses the app/script path and filesystem candidates.
entries.returns: Appends the context object to the target CSV file.
entries.errors: Requires filename and record; invalid data or file writes can fail.

parameters.name: record
parameters.description: Context data or assignment target, as shown in the signature.

entries.name: json.read
entries.summary: Read a JSON file and parse its contents.
entries.returns: Parsed JSON is written to the assignment target and ___last_exec_result___.
entries.errors: Requires a filename and assignment target. File-read and JSON-parse failures return builtin errors.

entries.name: load-rune
entries.summary: Load a Rune file or directory, resolving its top-level imports before parsing.
entries.returns: Document data in JSON form by default, or an XML string when as xml is supplied.
entries.errors: Requires a path; loading/parsing failure is an error. The explicit conversion form supports xml.

entries.name: datasource
entries.summary: Dispatch a schema-based database operation through a configured native MySQL or PostgreSQL source.
entries.returns: Operation-dependent result or side effect. Supported actions: create_table, fetch_all, fetch, insert, update, delete.
entries.errors: Unknown source, missing connection/type, unsupported connection type, and database/query failures.
entries.example:
datasource create_table User in Users
datasource fetch_all User from Users into data
notes: Requires a native build and a reachable configured database. This entrypoint is a schema-operation dispatcher, not an arbitrary SQL query builtin.

entries.name: memory.set
entries.summary: Store a value in the process memory backend.
entries.returns: Uses an exact context-variable lookup for value; otherwise stores literal text. If omitted, value uses the key token.
entries.errors: Missing key is a builtin error.
notes: The implemented VECTRUNE_MEMORY_BACKEND is memory. State is process-local and is lost on restart.

entries.name: memory.get
entries.summary: Read a value from the process memory backend.
entries.returns: Assigns the stored JSON value and ___last_exec_result___ when found. A missing key logs a warning and leaves the context unchanged; it does not assign null.
entries.errors: Missing key is a builtin error.
notes: The implemented VECTRUNE_MEMORY_BACKEND is memory. State is process-local and is lost on restart.

entries.name: memory.del
entries.summary: Delete a key from the process memory backend.
entries.returns: Removes the key; no assigned result.
entries.errors: Missing key is a builtin error.
notes: The implemented VECTRUNE_MEMORY_BACKEND is memory. State is process-local and is lost on restart.

entries.name: memory.clear
entries.summary: Remove all keys from the process memory backend.
entries.returns: Clears the shared backend, not only the current request context.
notes: The implemented VECTRUNE_MEMORY_BACKEND is memory. State is process-local and is lost on restart.

entries.name: append
entries.summary: Append a resolved value to an array in the execution context.
entries.returns: Mutates the context array; an assignment target receives the updated value. Nested object paths are supported by this builtin.
entries.errors: Missing/non-array targets and invalid nested paths can fail.
notes: memory.append is a dispatcher alias for append. It is not a separate atomic operation that fetches a backend key; load and store shared state explicitly.

entries.name: delete
entries.summary: Delete a top-level context variable or nested object property.
entries.returns: Mutates the current context. Missing targets are ignored.
entries.errors: Missing path is a builtin error.

entries.name: is-set
entries.summary: Check whether a variable or resolved path exists in the execution context.
entries.returns: Boolean. An existing null value still counts as present.
entries.errors: Missing path is a builtin error.

entries.name: func
entries.summary: Register a sequence of semicolon-separated native steps in the current context.
entries.returns: Stores steps under func:<name>. Invocations expose positional arguments as $1, $2, ... and copy non-positional context values back to the caller.
entries.errors: Missing function name is a builtin error.
notes: This native func facility differs from Rune-Web action declarations.

entries.name: to-number
entries.summary: Convert a resolved number, numeric string, or boolean to a number.
entries.returns: A JSON number, or null for an unsupported/unparseable value. Booleans map to 1 and 0.

entries.name: to-string
entries.summary: Convert a context value or literal token to a string.
entries.returns: Existing strings are preserved; other JSON values are serialized. No argument produces an empty string.

entries.name: to-bool
entries.summary: Convert a context value to a boolean.
entries.returns: Strings are true only for case-insensitive true or exactly 1. Numbers are true when nonzero; null is false; objects and arrays are true. No argument is false.

entries.name: uuid.v4
entries.summary: Generate a random version 4 UUID.
entries.returns: Hyphenated UUID string.

entries.name: now
entries.summary: Read the current UTC time.
entries.returns: Default: RFC 3339 string. millis: Unix milliseconds. unix or seconds: Unix seconds.

entries.name: summarize
entries.summary: Group records into an ordered, non-mutating report.
entries.returns: Array of groups in first-occurrence order, with counts and the requested metric. Missing group fields join the null group.
entries.errors: Invalid syntax, non-array input, unsupported metrics, invalid paths, and non-numeric metric values can fail.
entries.example: report = summarize sales by region sum amount

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: sum, avg, min, max, median, distinct, first, or last. Omit for counts.

entries.name: ws.id
entries.summary: Read the identifier of the current WebSocket connection.
entries.returns: Connection ID string, or null outside a connection context.
notes: Native server operation; unavailable in a wasm32 build of the Rust dispatcher.

entries.name: ws.send
entries.summary: Send a message to one WebSocket connection.
entries.returns: Queues a message in the process-local connection registry.
entries.errors: Requires a path, connection ID, and message.
notes: Native server operation; unavailable in a wasm32 build of the Rust dispatcher.

entries.name: ws.broadcast
entries.summary: Broadcast a message to connections registered on a WebSocket path.
entries.returns: Queues the message for connections on the supplied path.
entries.errors: Requires a path and message.
notes: Native server operation; unavailable in a wasm32 build of the Rust dispatcher.

entries.name: return
entries.summary: Finish a native resolver or step sequence with a resolved value.
entries.returns: The native dispatcher resolves the argument and returns it with success status; GraphQL resolver handling uses that result.

entries.name: array.find
entries.summary: Find the first element satisfying a native comparison.
entries.returns: First matching JSON value, or null. it refers to the current element.
entries.errors: The native method requires a supported comparison rather than an arbitrary callback.

entries.name: array.find-index
entries.summary: Find the index of the first matching native array element.
entries.returns: Zero-based index, or -1 when no match is found.

entries.name: array.max
entries.summary: Compute the maximum numeric element or selected object field.
entries.returns: Maximum number; an empty array returns 0. Non-numeric selected values contribute 0.

entries.name: array.remove
entries.summary: Remove one element by zero-based index.
entries.returns: Mutates the context array. Negative and out-of-range indices are ignored.
entries.errors: Missing index is a builtin error.

entries.name: import
entries.summary: Load top-level Rune imports before parsing the final document.
notes: Directories load Rune source files; import-cycle and missing-file diagnostics are handled by the loader.

entries.name: section
entries.summary: Create a hierarchical named section. Section names select runtime behavior when recognized by an app; arbitrary sections can hold user data.

entries.name: value
entries.summary: Declare a scalar or structured value in a section. Runtime expressions and declaration literals are parsed by different layers.

entries.name: record
entries.summary: Start a record; subsequent indented properties extend that record.

entries.name: series
entries.summary: Declare an ordered series. Executable run blocks and declarative data series share this document shape.

entries.name: if
entries.summary: Execute an indented conditional block.
notes: Frontend actions also support conditionals, interpreted by the Rune-Web runtime.

entries.name: path lookup
entries.summary: Resolve dotted or bracketed paths against the current context.
notes: Path resolution differs between builtins; see the per-function entry for argument lookup behavior.

entries.name: comment
entries.summary: Add a comment to Rune source. A shebang-like #!RUNE header identifies a document.

entries.name: .vect
entries.summary: Run imperative script syntax through the shared execution intermediate representation.
notes: The script engine supports actions, for/while loops, break/continue, return, input, print, and builtin statements. This does not imply every form is accepted in native REST run series.

entries.name: .vectrune
entries.summary: Compile English-style workflow definitions into the execution engine.

entries.name: frontend action
entries.summary: Declare an action in a Rune-Web @Logic or component scope.

entries.name: frontend when
entries.summary: Run a registered frontend command only when its trailing condition evaluates true.

entries.name: frontend loops
entries.summary: Iterate a collection in frontend action logic or view templates.

entries.name: frontend match
entries.summary: Select a Rune-Web view branch by an expression.

entries.name: frontend bindings
entries.summary: Bind a frontend input or selection to reactive state.

entries.name: frontend interpolation
entries.summary: Insert an expression into frontend text or attributes.

entries.name: frontend replication
entries.summary: Generate repeated state values from templates.

entries.name: @App
entries.summary: Select an application runtime and its serving or presentation configuration.

fields.name: type
fields.description: REST, GraphQL, STATIC, DYNAMIC-AI-WEB, PIXEL, or PIXEL-3D; dispatch is case-insensitive.

fields.name: port
fields.description: HTTP port; can be overridden by --port.

fields.name: host
fields.description: HTTP bind address; can be overridden by --host.

fields.name: runtime
fields.description: Selects game host behavior, including hybrid examples.

fields.name: shell
fields.description: Optional Rune-Web @Page shell for Pixel 3D; must contain the game canvas.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Application metadata; does not select a versioned docs path.

entries.name: @Route
entries.summary: Define an HTTP endpoint and its executable steps.
notes: The REST router registers GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, and CRUD expansion. PATCH is not registered here.

fields.name: expect
fields.description: POST/PUT OpenAPI request body metadata; does not run validation.

fields.name: schema
fields.description: Schema used by generated data-source CRUD handlers.

fields.name: data_source
fields.description: Configured data source for generated handlers.

entries.name: @Schema
entries.summary: Declare object fields for validation, generated API schemas, and GraphQL types.
notes: Native scalar validation supports string, number, bool. Every declared field is required; extra properties are accepted.

entries.name: @GraphQL
entries.summary: Declare named resolver step series with typed arguments.

entries.name: @Websocket
entries.summary: Mount a WebSocket endpoint on a REST application.

fields.name: on_disconnect
fields.description: Run when receiving ends, before removal.

entries.name: @Event
entries.summary: Handle a structured WebSocket message selected by its JSON type property.

entries.name: @Authentication
entries.summary: Configure JWT-protected routes and an optional token endpoint.
notes: This is a small JWT facility. Review the implementation and configure secrets explicitly before using it in a deployed service.

fields.name: token_credentials
fields.description: Expected username and password for HTTP Basic authentication at the token endpoint.

entries.name: @DataSource
entries.summary: Configure a native database adapter.

entries.name: @Memory
entries.summary: Seed shared state from section properties or records.
notes: Shared memory is process-local with the implemented memory backend; it is not persistent storage.

entries.name: @Frontend
entries.summary: Mount a static or Rune-Web frontend through REST hosting.

entries.name: @Page
entries.summary: Declare a Rune-Web page, or a descriptive generated page in a dynamic AI app.

entries.name: @Component
entries.summary: Declare a reusable frontend view with local scope.
notes: props: [name, subtitle?] marks subtitle optional; undeclared props do not undergo the required-prop check.

entries.name: @Logic
entries.summary: Declare reactive state and actions for a frontend or game scene.

fields.name: action
fields.description: Named action bodies with optional parameters.

fields.name: locals
fields.description: Template-local values not exported as public state.

fields.name: derived
fields.description: Derived values evaluated from state using match definitions.

fields.name: helper
fields.description: Pure helper expressions with named parameters.

fields.name: timer
fields.description: Periodic action ticker such as tick 40ms.

entries.name: @Style
entries.summary: Declare design tokens, presets, selector rules, and responsive overrides.

entries.name: @I18N
entries.summary: Declare translation data resolved by %i18n.path% or frontend interpolation.

entries.name: @Navigator
entries.summary: Synchronize a state variable with path, query, or hash navigation.

fields.name: url bound to
fields.description: State variable representing the active route.

fields.name: param
fields.description: Query parameter used by query navigation.

entries.name: @Optimizer
entries.summary: Split named route views into lazy-loadable JSON chunks.

entries.name: @SEO
entries.summary: Declare default or route-specific metadata for title, description, and social image.

entries.name: @Site
entries.summary: Provide generated-site title, description, tone, style, and navigation.
notes: These are generation inputs for dynamic-ai-web, not ordinary Rune-Web components.

entries.name: @Content
entries.summary: Supply descriptive content to the AI generation context.
notes: These are generation inputs for dynamic-ai-web, not ordinary Rune-Web components.

entries.name: @Data
entries.summary: Supply structured records to generated pages and API responses.
notes: These are generation inputs for dynamic-ai-web, not ordinary Rune-Web components.

entries.name: abs
entries.summary: Absolute numeric value.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: floor
entries.summary: Round a numeric value downward.
entries.returns: Integer-valued number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: sqrt
entries.summary: Compute the square root.
entries.returns: Number; negative input follows JavaScript NaN behavior.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: sin
entries.summary: Sine with a degree input.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: cos
entries.summary: Cosine with a degree input.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: atan2
entries.summary: Compute a direction in degrees.
entries.returns: Angle normalized into [0, 360).
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: clamp
entries.summary: Constrain a numeric value to bounds.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: min
entries.summary: Return the minimum numeric argument.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: max
entries.summary: Return the maximum numeric argument.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: random
entries.summary: Generate an integer within the requested range.
entries.returns: Random integer; an explicit seed allows repeatability.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: shuffle
entries.summary: Return a seeded shuffled copy of an array.
entries.returns: Array; input is not shuffled in place.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: pick
entries.summary: Choose a value from an array.
entries.returns: Selected value; an empty array yields null.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: collide
entries.summary: Check axis-aligned proximity of objects with x/y coordinates.
entries.returns: Boolean; invalid objects return false.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: distance
entries.signature: distance(a, b) | distance(ax, ay, bx, by)
entries.summary: Compute Euclidean distance between points.
entries.returns: Number.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: angle_to
entries.summary: Find the direction from one point object to another.
entries.returns: Angle in degrees normalized into [0, 360); invalid objects return 0.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: slide
entries.summary: Move a circle through the active grid collision space with sliding.
entries.returns: Position object returned by the spatial runtime.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: sees
entries.signature: sees(a, b) | sees(x1, y1, x2, y2)
entries.summary: Check line of sight through the active map.
entries.returns: Boolean.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: map_spawn
entries.summary: Read a compiled map spawn point.
entries.returns: Map spawn data from the current spatial configuration.
notes: Rune-Web expression helper. Availability is not implied for native REST run blocks.

entries.name: storage.get
entries.summary: Read JSON-backed local storage.
entries.returns: Stored value or fallback.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: storage.has
entries.summary: Test for a local-storage key.
entries.returns: Boolean.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: storage.set
entries.summary: Serialize a value to local storage.
entries.returns: Storage side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: storage.remove
entries.summary: Remove a local-storage key.
entries.returns: Storage side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: download
entries.summary: Download text content through the browser host.
entries.returns: Download side effect. No assigned return contract.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: clipboard.copy
entries.summary: Copy text using the host clipboard helper.
entries.returns: Clipboard side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: fullscreen.toggle
entries.summary: Toggle fullscreen presentation and the host fallback CSS state.
entries.returns: Updates presentation and is_fullscreen when state is available.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: fullscreen.enter
entries.summary: Request fullscreen presentation.
entries.returns: Host-dependent fullscreen side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: fullscreen.exit
entries.summary: Exit fullscreen presentation.
entries.returns: Host-dependent fullscreen side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: sound.play
entries.summary: Play a declared synthesized sound.
entries.returns: Audio side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: music.play
entries.summary: Start a declared or composed music track.
entries.returns: Audio playback side effect.
notes: Rune-Web host/runtime API. Browser permission, user-gesture, storage, or audio capabilities may constrain the operation.

entries.name: music.stop
entries.summary: Stop current music playback.
entries.returns: Audio side effect.

entries.name: music.pause
entries.summary: Pause current music playback.
entries.returns: Audio side effect.

entries.name: music.resume
entries.summary: Resume paused music.
entries.returns: Audio side effect.

entries.name: music.tempo
entries.summary: Set current music tempo.
entries.returns: Updates the audio engine tempo.

entries.name: music.volume
entries.summary: Set music playback volume.
entries.returns: Updates audio engine volume.

entries.name: music.compose
entries.signature: music.compose(name, lead, bass, drums[, time_signature[, bars]])
entries.summary: Register or update a composed music track.
entries.returns: Audio definition side effect.

entries.name: music.compose_song

entries.returns: Audio definition side effect.

entries.name: music.sync_steps
entries.summary: Synchronize Rune Studio step state with its song representation.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio-related state.

entries.name: music.select_step
entries.summary: Select a Rune Studio piano-roll step.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio selection state.

entries.name: music.delete_step
entries.summary: Delete a Rune Studio step by ID.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio step state.

entries.name: music.stretch_step
entries.summary: Change a Rune Studio note step duration.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio step state.

entries.name: music.stack_chord_note
entries.summary: Stack a note into an existing Rune Studio step.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio step state.

entries.name: music.duplicate_bar
entries.summary: Duplicate a Rune Studio bar.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio sequence state.

entries.name: music.delete_bar
entries.summary: Delete a Rune Studio bar.
entries.returns: Mutates Studio sequence state.

entries.name: emitter.burst
entries.summary: Emit particles from a state-declared emitter.
entries.returns: Appends particle records, capped by the emitter maximum.

entries.name: emitter.step
entries.summary: Advance particles, applying friction/gravity and expiring life.
entries.returns: Mutates the emitter particle array.

entries.name: restore
entries.summary: Restore initial state or entity start_ fields.
entries.returns: Mutates the target. Entity fallback also sets alive to true.

entries.name: call
entries.summary: Invoke a named frontend action from a statement.
entries.returns: Action-dependent state effects.

entries.name: @Scene
entries.summary: Bind game logic, maps, assets, cameras, input, and HUD presentation.
entries.example:
@Scene/level
logic = game
map = dungeon
camera = player

fields.name: logic
fields.description: Named @Logic; Pixel 3D requires start and tick actions.

fields.name: camera
fields.description: Camera state field or a declared cinematic camera.

fields.name: things
fields.description: State collection names rendered as scene objects.

fields.name: hud
fields.description: State-field bindings for legacy HUD values.

fields.name: keys
fields.description: Keyboard mapping when no custom mapping is supplied.

fields.name: world
fields.description: Voxel world state field; must exist.

fields.name: ui
fields.description: Structured HUD state field; must exist.

fields.name: pause_ui
fields.description: Pause HUD state field; must exist.

fields.name: restart_action
fields.description: Action invoked for restart; must exist.

fields.name: persistence
fields.description: key and state; key is 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, hyphens, or underscores.

fields.name: presentation
fields.description: title, subtitle, objective, victory, defeat, and up to five instruction strings.

entries.name: @Map
entries.summary: Declare a grid environment and optional visual floor, ceiling, sky, and spawn.

fields.name: ceiling
fields.description: Opaque #RRGGBB or texture; mutually exclusive with sky.

fields.name: ceiling_height
fields.description: Greater than 0.5 and no more than 16; visual elevation.

entries.name: @Palette
entries.summary: Map single ASCII symbols to colors for pixel assets.

fields.name: colors
fields.description: 1–256 entries mapping single ASCII characters to #RRGGBB or transparent.

entries.name: @Texture
entries.summary: Compile an opaque indexed pixel texture.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Pixel dimensions validated by the compiler.

fields.name: pixels
fields.description: Literal rows; texture compilation also supports row/runs/pattern objects with repeat.

fields.name: patterns
fields.description: Reusable run patterns for compact texture rows.

entries.name: @Sprite
entries.summary: Compile an indexed pixel sprite or animation frame.

fields.name: size
fields.description: Pixel dimensions validated by the compiler.

fields.name: pixels
fields.description: Literal pixel rows matching the declared dimensions.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Sprite origin, when supported by the asset compiler.

entries.name: @Model
entries.summary: Declare a palette-colored block model. Models are visual geometry, not collision geometry.

entries.name: model instance
entries.summary: Place a compiled model through a scene thing record.

fields.name: dissolve
fields.description: Deterministic fragment discard from 0 to 1; discarded pixels do not write depth.

entries.name: @Perspective
entries.summary: Declare a camera field of view.

fields.name: fov
fields.description: Finite field of view between 20 and 120 degrees.

entries.name: @Camera
entries.summary: Declare a timed cinematic camera track.

fields.name: points
fields.description: 2–128 points, each with finite x, y, angle; optional height (default 0.5), pitch (default 0, range -85..85).

entries.name: @Controls
entries.summary: Declare portable keyboard, pointer, touch, and gamepad controls.
entries.example:
@Controls/game
keys:
    Space -> fire
commands:
    KeyP -> host.pause

fields.name: extends
fields.description: Parent profile name; inheritance is validated for cycles and depth.

fields.name: gamepad
fields.description: Button/axis -> input or host command; optional scale, invert, deadzone, mode.

fields.name: touch
fields.description: Joystick, look surface, and buttons. Touch objects may bind visibility to boolean state paths.

entries.name: @Sound
entries.summary: Define a synthesized sound effect.

fields.name: wave
fields.description: sawtooth, square, triangle, sine, or noise.

entries.name: @Music
entries.summary: Define a chiptune or synth song.

fields.name: lead / bass / drums
fields.description: Built-in tracks; custom named tracks are also supported.

fields.name: sections
fields.description: Reusable named sections: each has integer bars (1-64) and channel-to-note-string fields. Missing/short channels are padded with rests; overlong phrases are rejected. Use with arrangement instead of top-level tracks/bars.

fields.name: arrangement
fields.description: Ordered section names or {section, repeat} cues; repeat accepts integers 1-16. Up to 32 sections, 128 cues and 512 expanded bars in 4/4 or 3/4. loop repeats the full arrangement.

fields.name: instruments
fields.description: Channel-to-synth-voice map. Supports square, sine, triangle, bass, sawtooth, synth, pluck, drums, brass, strings and bell. Works with legacy tracks and arranged sections in browser/native hosts.

entries.name: @Test
entries.summary: Declare a test with run steps. Native tests use an in-process router; frontend tests use the logic harness.
entries.returns: A result in the CLI test report.
notes: Test-only declaration or command; availability depends on the selected test type.

entries.name: @TestSuite
entries.summary: Declare suite-level setup and teardown steps.

notes: Test-only declaration or command; availability depends on the selected test type.

entries.name: @TestFixture
entries.summary: Declare reusable fixture setup and teardown.

notes: Test-only declaration or command; availability depends on the selected test type.

entries.name: assert
entries.summary: Assert a condition in a native or frontend logic test.
entries.returns: Records an assertion or fails the test.
notes: Test-only declaration or command; availability depends on the selected test type.

entries.name: test-request
entries.summary: Send a request through the in-process native application router.

req = { method: "GET", path: "/health" }
res = test-request req
notes: Test-only declaration or command; availability depends on the selected test type.

entries.name: invoke
entries.signature: invoke <action> [JSON value or JSON argument array]
entries.summary: Invoke a frontend action in the headless logic harness.
entries.returns: Action effects in test state.
notes: Test-only declaration or command; availability depends on the selected test type.

entries.name: body
entries.summary: Raw request body, replaced by parsed JSON after an unassigned parse-json call.
entries.returns: String initially; parsed JSON after conversion.

entries.name: path.params
entries.summary: Object containing string-valued URL parameters. Each parameter is also inserted directly into the native context.
entries.returns: Parameter object or selected string.

entries.name: ___last_exec_result___
entries.summary: Context slot written by builtins that expose a last execution result.
entries.returns: Builtin-dependent value; not every builtin writes it.

entries.name: VECTRUNE_MEMORY_BACKEND
entries.summary: Choose the implemented shared-memory backend.
entries.returns: memory is supported. Other values panic during backend initialization.

entries.name: dynamic-ai-web options

fields.name: engine

entries.name: voxel_move
entries.signature: voxel_move(world, player, dx, dy[, jump=false[, options]])
entries.summary: Advance movement with voxel collision, gravity, jumping, and elevation.
entries.returns: Updated player state.
notes: Optional movement settings: jumpSpeed in (0, 1], gravity in (0, 0.3], autoStep boolean. Defaults: 0.28, 0.035, true. Falling speed is capped at 0.3 tiles per tick.
Voxel scene helper; implemented in the shared JavaScript game runtime. The legacy Rust grid rasterizer does not render voxel worlds.

entries.name: voxel_target

notes: Voxel scene helper; implemented in the shared JavaScript game runtime. The legacy Rust grid rasterizer does not render voxel worlds.

entries.name: voxel_get

entries.returns: Block identifier.
notes: Voxel scene helper; implemented in the shared JavaScript game runtime. The legacy Rust grid rasterizer does not render voxel worlds.

entries.name: voxel_fill
entries.summary: Fill or carve a rectangular block region.
entries.returns: Mutated world object.
notes: Voxel scene helper; implemented in the shared JavaScript game runtime. The legacy Rust grid rasterizer does not render voxel worlds.

coverage.native: All names and aliases in the native is_builtin registry are checked against this catalog.
coverage.web: Registered frontend commands, signatures, and aliases are extracted from their source definitions.
coverage.cli: Command usage and flags are read recursively from the build compiler help.
coverage.other: Declarations, syntax, configuration, and host APIs are curated against linked implementation files. These families are documented at different levels of detail; arbitrary user section names and internal Rust/TypeScript methods are not public dictionary entries.
